XRPUSDT 2023-06: K=1 scores below Poisson on test

verdict.headline: Across 10 symbol-month(s), the neural model's held-out timing likelihood is +0.5765 nats per event over Poisson (median), and +0.0525 over the validation-selected Hawkes (median, range +0.0340 to +0.2642). The day-block 95% interval for neural minus best Hawkes lies above zero on 10 of 10, below zero on 0, and contains zero on 0. Median share of the Poisson-to-neural gain already captured by each Hawkes: K=1 76%, K=2 90%, K=3 91%.
verdict.reading: On 10 of 10 the gap is both resolved and at least 0.01 nats per event, so on this sample the linear self-exciting form leaves one-step-ahead timing structure unexplained.
